scope: Explicit compatible API symmetry boundary and independent zero-field Re=20 cylinder start; research driver only, no legacy default change.

symmetryBoundary.apiKindAtRecordedRun: Symmetry in local research commit b1768f5; after ordinary merge, the strictly more general public kind is NormalVelocity with zero normalVelocity and zero tangentialTraction callbacks.
symmetryBoundary.meaning: Only the callback velocity dotted with the outward unit normal is prescribed; both P1 tangential face moments remain unknown.
symmetryBoundary.implementation: Each straight boundary face uses an orthogonal tangent/normal change of basis before local condensation and converts saved physical x/y traces at the API boundary. The merged NormalVelocity interface additionally supports nonzero tangential traction.

coldStart.initialField: zero coefficients followed only by exact boundary trace imposition

comparisonToPriorMediumContinuationDiagn.note: The earlier full reference state was not re-read in this run, so these are diagnostic differences, not a whole-field norm.

limitations: This compatible discretization differs from the legacy collocated FVM, so its bounded result does not silently select a legacy nonlinear branch or prove the old stencil repaired.
Only one independent medium-grid cold start is added; general uniqueness is not established.
The 27,511 matrix products, 100-restart requirement and about 1.18 GiB observed peak RSS (1,237,504 KiB) are not yet acceptable as the default backend.
Local curved-wall pressure and wall traction accuracy still require a sufficient spatial/geometric sequence.

This batch did not rerun the merged explicit CLI end to end; its separate boundary/CLI evidence remains in native-laminar-compatible-boundary-cli.json. No desktop, macOS or packaged-app integration is claimed here.
